report: AI, Robotics, and the Future of Jobs
publisher: Pew Research Center's Internet Project and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center
series: Digital Life in 2025 (Future of the Internet VI)

entries.label: AI and robots displace more jobs than they create
entries.quote: Self-driving cars, intelligent digital agents that can act for you, and robots are advancing rapidly. Will networked, automated, artificial intelligence (AI) applications and robotic devices have displaced more jobs than they have created by 2025?
entries.subject: AI and robotics job displacement

notes: One yes/no question from the Future of the Internet VI canvassing (eight questions, published as separate 2014 reports). share_agree is the share answering 'yes', share_disagree the share answering 'no'. Respondents were asked to elaborate; the reports say some answers were hopes, not predictions. Non-random opt-in canvassing.
